target_customer: Developers building AI agents that need to search, fetch and crawl the web
problem: Agents get lossy or incomplete web data; the product returns Markdown and hidden data from pages with a vision model.
business_model: Usage-based API: $1 per 1,000 credits, fetch 1 credit, search 1.5 credits, enterprise custom pricing
product_category: Web data API for AI agents

founders.name: Tim Suchanek
founders.background_notes: From the YC page; the page says 8 to 10 years in developer tools.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable crawling plus a vision model for extraction is standard engineering with hard parts at scale.

defensibility.rationale: Many fetch and crawl APIs exist; benchmark claims are self run and not independently verified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: By 2026 several players launched fetch APIs (Browserbase, TinyFish) and Cloudflare a search API; this is from undated or 2026 pages.

market_need_then: AI agents needing web access was a rising need in 2024; no company specific demand evidence found.

identity.voice_and_tone: agent vision metaphors: reading glasses, let your agent see the web

branding.brand_signature: Let your agent see the web

brand_strength.rationale: Clear metaphor and a model named Iris, but a generic name and thin press.

outcome_analysis: expand.ai is an active YC S24 company that launched Expand Fetch in October 2026 per a write-up, with self reported benchmark wins. No independent funding, exit or failure source was found. It enters a crowded web data API market, so durability depends on accuracy and pricing against better funded rivals.
notes: Funding: startupintros and VCBacked list $500K in September 2024 with Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund and Charly Poly, seed vs pre-seed conflict; aggregators only, unverified and not recorded as a round. Stellate and Prisma history is from the YC page only. Competitor search found only 2026 products, none dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Update: the $500K of September 2024 rests on Startupintros (labelled seed) and VCBacked (labelled pre-seed, with the investors); stage recorded as other because they conflict. Single database basis; an extra search found no corroboration.
